text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is finally here, and
among the
elite runners of the Ultimate
Era...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A young racer steps up to challenge
them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, d'you wanna try jumping out the
starting
gate? Could be fun.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
There's Голд Шип, the Double Crown
champion
this year, who's rocked up at
Nakayama with a
full head of steam.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Stop bothering me before the race!
Besides, no
one is foolish enough to
jump out of the gate!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Aw, man... I'm really not feelin' it today,
so I
thought if you did that, it'd help me
get in the
mood to race...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yeesh, doesn't anyone have drive
nowadays?
Fine, I'll just have to do this
myself.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Golshi's gonna let loose!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Today's race is filled with nothing but

unconventional and unwieldy racers from
every
generation.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: If I take first place against all of them...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I can finish my career on a beautiful note
as a
racer with glory to her name.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It'll be a magnificent and fitting end to it
all.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Her words sound so final... I can't hold
my tongue
anymore.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Is this... a schedule for races after the
Arima
Kinen?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Did you make this?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
Yes. Though it might be a little rough around
the edges...

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it needs some adjustments, but
may I ask
why you drafted it in the first
place?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Because I want you to keep racing!

text_block_list.text:
Maybe, just maybe, if running still has a
place in
the most important timetable of
her life, then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I want to see you run!

text_block_list.text:
Trainer. This notebook contains a
schedule I
mapped out for the next ten
years of my life.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Riiip! Rip! RIP!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...That made me feel a great deal guiltier
than I
anticipated.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Earlier, I said that this would be the
end... but
that final ending of mine has
yet to be decided.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I have already made my parents proud.

Therefore, I no longer have a reason to
continue
running.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However, my desire to keep running, to
keep
racing—it's still here, and it's as
strong as ever.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
So I asked myself, "What would those I
admire do
in this situation?"
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My parents would likely maintain their

predetermined trajectory to the end.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
In your case, however... I believe you
would say
that pursuing my desire to
keep racing would be
the right thing to
do.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let's create a schedule for my future
plans when
we get back.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This Arima Kinen isn't the end of my
career, but
the beginning of our new
path together...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And so, I shall claim a worthy victory for
you!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
